title: adiantum tenerum var. farleyense
intro: Adiantum tenerum var. farleyense, commonly known as Farley's Maidenhair Fern, is a variety of the Adiantum tenerum species, which belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Adiantum tenerum var. farleyense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant also show promise in modulating immune responses and exhibiting neuroprotective effects.
